channel.description: Sample feed for tests. Not a real subscription.

item.title: How We Make The Rest Is History
item.description: Tom and Dominic pull back the curtain: how episodes get chosen, how the research happens, and what they argue about most.

item.title: Live in London: The Hundred Years' War
item.description: Recorded live at the Royal Festival Hall: Tom and Dominic on Edward III, the Black Prince, Agincourt, and how England and France made one another.

item.title: The Late Bronze Age Collapse
item.description: Around 1200 BC, the great palace civilisations of the eastern Mediterranean — Mycenae, the Hittites, the New Kingdom of Egypt — all collapsed within a century. Tom and Dominic on the Sea Peoples, climate change, and the end of an age.

item.title: In Conversation with Bettany Hughes
item.description: Tom Holland sits down with Bettany Hughes to talk about her career as a historian and broadcaster, and the joys and perils of writing popular history.

item.title: The Fall of Constantinople, Part 2: The Siege
item.description: Mehmed II's seven-week siege of the walls of Theodosius, the death of the last Roman emperor, and the end of the Middle Ages.

item.title: The Fall of Constantinople, Part 1: The City
item.description: The thousand-year history of Constantinople, from its founding by Constantine the Great to the eve of the Ottoman siege of 1453.

item.title: The Mongol Empire
item.description: The largest contiguous land empire in history. Tom and Dominic on how a confederation of steppe horsemen conquered from the Pacific to the Danube.

item.title: Augustus: First Roman Emperor
item.description: From the chaos of civil war to the Pax Romana — how Octavian became Augustus and ruled an empire spanning the Mediterranean for over forty years.

item.title: The Ides of March
item.description: Tom and Dominic on the assassination of Julius Caesar on 15 March 44 BC, and how a single act of conspiracy in the Theatre of Pompey reshaped the Mediterranean world.

item.title: Abraham Lincoln
item.description: From Kentucky log cabin to the White House: the life and presidency of America's sixteenth president, and the Civil War that defined him.

item.title: Listener Questions: Ancient Rome
item.description: Tom and Dominic answer listener questions about Roman gladiators, latrines, slavery, and just what exactly happened at a triumph.

item.title: The Birth of Christianity
item.description: From the Judean countryside under Roman occupation to a movement that would, within centuries, conquer the empire that crucified its founder.

item.title: Bonus: A Roman Saturnalia
item.description: A Club-only festive special: Tom and Dominic on the riotous Roman midwinter festival of Saturnalia — the inversion of the social order, the gambling, the gifts, and what survives in our own Christmas.
